parameters.query:
SELECT session_id, current_step, answers, completed, false AS is_new_session
FROM kyc_sessions
WHERE session_id = $1
UNION ALL
SELECT $1::text, 0, '{}'::jsonb, false, true AS is_new_session
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kyc_sessions WHERE session_id = $1)
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE kyc_sessions
SET current_step = {{ $json.current_step }},
    answers = jsonb_set(answers, '{"{{ $json.answered_field_name }}"}', to_jsonb('{{ $json.answered_value }}'::text))
WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.session_id }}'
RETURNING session_id, current_step, answers;

UPDATE kyc_sessions
SET current_step = {{ $json.current_step }},
    answers = jsonb_set(answers, '{"{{ $json.answered_field_name }}"}', to_jsonb('{{ $json.answered_value }}'::text)),
    completed = true
WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.session_id }}'
RETURNING session_id, answers;

INSERT INTO customer_kyc (
    session_id, full_name, dob, address, id_type, id_number,
    phone, email, occupation, income_range, is_pep,
    ai_validation_status, ai_notes
)
VALUES (
    '{{ $json.session_id }}',
    '{{ $json.full_name }}',
    '{{ $json.dob }}',
    '{{ $json.address }}',
    '{{ $json.id_type }}',
    '{{ $json.id_number }}',
    '{{ $json.phone }}',
    '{{ $json.email }}',
    '{{ $json.occupation }}',
    '{{ $json.income_range }}',
    '{{ $json.is_pep }}',
    '{{ $json.ai_validation_status }}',
    '{{ $json.ai_notes }}'
)
RETURNING id, full_name, ai_validation_status, submitted_at;
